  selector:
    app: redis-cluster

spec:

    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cluster
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis
  labels:
    app: redis-cluster
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: redis-cluster
spec:
  serviceName: redis-headless
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cluster
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
  podManagementPolicy: Parallel
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cluster
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: redis-cluster
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 999
        runAsGroup: 999
        fsGroup: 999
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: redis-cluster
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: redis-cluster
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
            - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: redis-auth
                  key: password
          command: ["/bin/sh","-c"]
          args:
            - >
              exec redis-server /conf/redis.conf
              --cluster-announce-ip ${POD_IP}
              --cluster-announce-port 6379
              --cluster-announce-bus-port 16379
              --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
              --masterauth ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: 6379
              protocol: TCP
            - name: cluster-bus
              containerPort: 16379
              protocol: TCP
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - 'redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 ping | grep PONG'
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 5
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - 'redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 ping | grep PONG'
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command:
                  - /bin/sh
                  - -c
                  - 'redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 shutdown nosave || true'
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: "1Gi"
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: config
              mountPath: /conf
              readOnly: true
        - name: cluster-init
          image: redis:7-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          env:
            - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: redis-auth
                  key: password
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
          command: ["/bin/sh","-c"]
          args:
            - >
              if [ "${POD_NAME##*-}" != "0" ]; then
                sleep infinity;
              fi;
              for i in 0 1 2; do
                until redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" -h redis-$i.redis-headless -p 6379 ping | grep -q PONG; do
                  sleep 2;
                done;
              done;
              if redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" -h redis-0.redis-headless -p 6379 cluster info 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'cluster_state:ok'; then
                echo "Cluster already configured";
              else
                redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --cluster create \
                  redis-0.redis-headless:6379 \
                  redis-1.redis-headless:6379 \
                  redis-2.redis-headless:6379 \
                  --cluster-replicas 0 --cluster-yes;
              fi;
              sleep infinity
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "50m"
              memory: "64Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: redis-config
            items:
              - key: redis.conf
                path: redis.conf
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
        labels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
          app.kubernetes.io/part-of: redis-cluster
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi

kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:

  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: redis-cluster
spec:

          protocol: TCP

      ports:
        - protocol: UDP

        - protocol: TCP

        - protocol: TCP

        - protocol: TCP
